name: Saimin Nikki
source:
Officialy, Kuzuhara Ryoutarou is the counsellor of a prestigious school. He takes care of the mental state of the students who come to him seeking help.
In truth, he is an conditioner that gives special training by hypnosis to schoolgirls for VIP who make generous donations to the educational institution.

Today, two girls came to ask for psychological help. Between Ninomiya and Kohinata, which will you choose to make it a perfect slave?
translation:
表面上，葛原良太郎是某所名校的心理辅导员，负责照顾前来求助的学生，帮助她们调整心理状态。

实际上，他却是一名调教师，专门用催眠手段对女学生实施“特殊训练”，再将她们献给那些向教育机构慷慨捐款的权贵。

今天，又有两名少女前来寻求心理帮助。二之宫静音与小日向奈月之间，你会选择谁，将她调教成完美的奴隶？
